history.dynasty: Tradition attributes origin to Patiala state era; present structure modern
history.summary: UNVERIFIED HISTORY: one travel account (MakeMyTrip) says Maharaja Amar Singh of Patiala built a shrine here when the West Jamuna canal split off in 1770; no corroborating source was found, so treat the 18th-century origin as tradition only. The present temple at Devi Bhawan Colony on FC College Road is a modern complex with a Durga sanctum, statues of many Hindu deities, a gaushala and a park. It is among Hisar's most visited temples, crowded on weekends and during Navratri.

name: Devi Bhawan Mandir
town_description: Hisar is a city in northwestern Haryana founded in 1354 as Hisar-e-Firoza by Firoz Shah Tughlaq. It is a major agricultural and industrial hub (notably steel) and an important rail junction in the state. The city and its surroundings have deep archaeological roots, with sites linked to the Indus Valley and early historic periods.
